Treasurer
Physical Address:
524 Central Ave
New Rockford, ND 58356
Mailing Address:
,
Office Hours Monday-Thursday 8am-4pm and Friday 8am-1pm
(701) 947-2434 (p) (701) 947-2279 (f)
The current Eddy County Treasurer is Becki Schumacher.
As the Treasurer she performs the following duties:
Collects property taxes and disburses tax monies to taxing districts.
Invests county funds for availability, safety and rate of return.
Provides lenders, realty agents, lawyers and other public and private agent's information on land values, mill levies, tax amounts, land ownership and legal descriptions.
Reconciles bank accounts.
Collects fees from county offices.
Pay your taxes online with a credit card or debit card! Take advantage of our fast, convenient payment options and pay your bills on time, on your time, every time .
www.OfficialPayments.com or call 1-800-2PAY-TAX (1-800-272-9829) - You will be asked for your county's Jurisdiction Code: 4419
